title: Reseller Discount on Certificate Auto-Renewals
content:
**Reseller desk note: auto-renew discount on SSL/TLS Certificates**

An auto-renew charge on an SSL/TLS Certificates subscription carries an auto-renew discount percentage that follows the tier recorded on the customer's Harborline Customer Accounts account on the day the charge falls due.

| Tier recorded on the Harborline Customer Accounts account on the day the charge falls due | Auto-renew discount percentage |
|---|---|
| Harborline Reseller Platinum | the SSL certificate discount percentage the Harborline Customer Accounts tier schedule sets for Harborline Reseller Platinum |
| Harborline Reseller Gold | the SSL certificate discount percentage the Harborline Customer Accounts tier schedule sets for Harborline Reseller Gold |
| Harborline Reseller Silver | the SSL certificate discount percentage the Harborline Customer Accounts tier schedule sets for Harborline Reseller Silver |
| Harborline Reseller Bronze | the SSL certificate discount percentage the Harborline Customer Accounts tier schedule sets for Harborline Reseller Bronze |
| any other tier | no auto-renew discount |

**What the percentage reduces.** The auto-renew discount percentage reduces only the certificate price component of the auto-renew charge, never its extra names: the extra names of the subscription are billed without this percentage.

**Which tier counts.** The tier is read from the account as it stands on the day the auto-renew charge falls due. A tier the account held before that day, or a tier it reaches afterwards, does not set the percentage.

**Basis questions**

- *A Harborline Business Account holds a certificate subscription that auto-renews. Is there an auto-renew discount?* No. Only the four reseller tiers listed above take an auto-renew discount percentage.
- *A Harborline Reseller Silver account's subscription records extra names. Does the tier percentage reach the names?* No. The percentage acts on the certificate price component alone.

**Hypothetical illustration (figures chosen for the example only).** Suppose a reseller tier's SSL certificate discount percentage were 13 percent and the certificate price component of an auto-renew charge came to 300.00 USD. The certificate price component is then reduced by 39.00 USD to 261.00 USD, and the extra names of the subscription are billed as they stand, without the 13 percent.
